Identify the top 5 industries most affec.title: New study sheds light on what kinds of workers are losing jobs to AI
Identify the top 5 industries most affec.summary: A study found that employment for workers aged 22 to 25 in the most AI-exposed sectors dropped 6% during the study period, while employment in those areas rose between 6% and 9% for older workers. The most affected fields include accounting and auditing, secretarial and administrative work, and computer programming.
key_points: Employment for workers aged 22 to 25 in the most AI-exposed sectors dropped 6% during the study period.
Employment in the most AI-exposed sectors rose between 6% and 9% for older workers.
Accounting and auditing, secretarial and administrative work, and computer programming are the most affected fields.
Older employees are more likely to have picked up the kinds of communication and other "soft" skills that are harder to teach and that employers may be reluctant to replace with AI.
